title: The Spartan Frame
author: Adam C.
desc:
Designed for post-cut transition, this program stabilizes body composition at maintenance calories before moving into a conservative surplus (+200 to +250 kcal/day). It aims to slowly build lean muscle mass, maximize V-taper aesthetics (upper chest, side delts, lats), and drive compound strength while keeping fat gain strictly controlled.

Execution Guidelines & Progression Rules

Schedule: 3 non-consecutive days per week (60–70 min/session).

Warm-Ups: 2–3 lighter sets before the first heavy lift.

Reverse Pyramid Training (RPT):

Set 1 (Top Set): Heavy set, lowest rep target (e.g., 4–6 reps) near failure.

Set 2: Reduce weight by 10%, add +2 reps (e.g., 6–8 reps).

Set 3: Reduce weight by another 10%, add +2 reps (e.g., 8–10 reps).

Rest: 3 minutes on RPT compound sets; 60–90 seconds on isolation work.

Weekly Workout Focus

Workout A (Upper Chest, Lats & Shoulders): Upper chest volume, heavy vertical pulling for lat width, and side delt isolation.

Workout B (Posterior Chain & Heavy Hinge): Heavy deadlifts, hamstring/glute strength, quad mass without high axial fatigue, and upper trap density.

Workout C (Overhead Strength, Upper Back & Arms): Shoulder pressing, horizontal row sweep, and focused bicep/tricep overload.

16-Week Structure Breakdown

Block 1: Foundations & Neural Adaptations (Weeks 1–8)

Weeks 1–3 (Maintenance / Acclimation): Run calories at maintenance. Establish baseline working weights, practice strict execution, and build neurological efficiency without excessive fatigue.

Weeks 4–8 (Early Lean Bulk): Increase intake to a +200–250 kcal surplus. High energy levels drive progressive overload across primary RPT lifts.

Deload Week (Week 9)

Cut total volume by 50% using moderate weights (RPE 6–7). Restores joint health and clears CNS fatigue before Block 2.

Block 2: Peak Hypertrophy & Overload (Weeks 10–16)

Weeks 10–16 (Peak Muscle Growth): Push aggressively for PRs on key RPT lifts (incline press, weighted chin-ups, deadlifts) to maximize upper body tissue accumulation.

Post-Program Protocol (After Week 16)

Assess Body Composition: Check waist measurements and visuals. If body fat remains safely under threshold (~15%), run another 12–16 week cycle.

Mini-Cut Option: If approaching ~15% body fat, run a brief 3–4 week deficit to strip fat before resuming a growth phase.
